Mo texts pleading him home; Nate brushes him off

s05058.summary: On a quiet dawn trawler, Anika calls it the quietest trip; Roy objects
A loose net slams into Teo and pins him to the deck
Anika assesses Teo's paralysis and directs Roy to hold his head
Anika promises Teo he'll be fine; Roy doubts; they roll him onto the board
